verdict.rationale: Helicone is an LLM gateway and observability platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API keys for agents is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes key scopes, permission levels, read-only or write-limited keys, or per-agent credential restrictions. The closest items are per-user rate limits, which are usage throttling rather than credential scoping, and bring-your-own provider keys; neither delivers least-privilege credentials.
